name: go-release
description: Use when the user cuts, plans, or reviews a Go release — a version tag, semver, breaking-change detection, a v2 module path, deprecating an API, go.mod hygiene before tagging, a changelog, or shipping binaries with GoReleaser. Also use when an exported API change to a published module needs a patch, minor, or major decision. Not for general Go code (use go), CLI construction (use cobra-viper), or design-doc review (use go-spec-reviewer).
